name: Gemini
description: Gemini's side navigation, a bard-sidenav element in the light DOM. Top links are found by address: the new chat is /app, and the library, images, scheduled and students links are relative in the page (library, images, ...), which resolve to /library and so on. The notebooks and chats sections are read through their expandable-section header buttons, so the rule doesn't depend on the hashed class names of the rows. The sidenav is a flex item beside the content, which takes the space once it's hidden, so no css is needed.
